original.statement: The Marathon provider has been removed in Traefik v3.0.0 and Marathon-related configuration is no longer supported.

decision.reason: [ev-c71146d39072] says that in v3 the Marathon provider has been removed. Its v2 static-configuration example uses the key `providers.marathon` (YAML `providers: marathon: {}`, TOML `[providers.marathon]`). It also says this configuration is now unsupported and would stop Traefik from starting. That supports a config-key subject at path `providers.marathon` with change type removed.
